newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Amati raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Amati raised to buy.

text.p: Dain Bosworth analyst Charles Pluckhahn said Monday he raised his rating on Amati Communications Corp to buy from neutral.
-- Last Friday, Amati said it will provide equipment for BC Telecom Inc's asymmetric digital subscriber line (ADSL) based services.
-- "By itself this isn't a very big deal, given British Columbia's relatively small population," Pluckhahn said in a report.
-- He said he expects that Amati will ship, at most, a few thousand lines this year and no more than 50,000 next year to this customer at a price of about $1,000 per line.

- "There is a broader significance to the deal, however, in that it marks the first commercial-scale deployment that we know of for the DMT (discrete multitone modulation) form of ADSL," the analyst said. "At least for the moment, the deal puts Amati at the head of the pack in the race to commercialize DMT, the technology that most players in the ADSL sector believe will emerge as the main choice of telecom companies in mass-scale deployments in the years ahead."
